title: TomasuLLM：面向LLM智能体的乱序推测执行运行时
summary: TomasuLLM 提出一种乱序执行智能体工具调用的运行时，通过推测未来动作、在写时复制沙箱中隔离运行、追踪依赖与副作用，并按轨迹顺序验证提交，从而在保证正确性的前提下加速长耗时工具调用。在 SWE-bench Verified 上提速 1.31 倍，Terminal-Bench 2.0 上 1.35 倍，SWE-Marathon 上 1.27 倍，且 4,010 条审计记录零误接受。
summary_en: TomasuLLM is a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. It achieves 1.31x on SWE-bench Verified, 1.35x on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 1.27x on SWE-Marathon, with zero false accepts across 4,010 audited commit-validation records.
